user.title: Configure Smart Light Curve
user.description: Set up a new room for intelligent lighting control. The controller will learn the room's physical properties and dynamically adjust the lights to match your target curve.

data_description.name: What should we call this room?
data_description.light_entity: The specific light or light group to control.
data_description.lux_sensor: The sensor measuring the current brightness in the room.
data_description.occupancy_sensor: The sensor that triggers the lights to turn on and off.
data_description.kp: How aggressively to correct for immediate light errors. (Default: 0.5)
data_description.ki: How much to correct for long-term drift. (Default: 0.01)
data_description.kd: How much to dampen the correction to prevent overshoot. (Default: 0.1)
data_description.update_interval: How often the controller evaluates and adjusts the light level. (Default: 5s)
